evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Large language model (LLM)-based agents increasingly rely on shared workflow repositories to transfer experience across tasks and agents.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Extensive experiments across multiple reasoning benchmarks show that workflow invalidation attacks achieve up to 90.12% success rates, degrading agent inference performance by up to 73.16 percentage points in accuracy without effective workflow protection.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: In addition, the proposed protection achieves an average F1 score of 85.26% and a detection rate of 79.97%, outperforming existing baselines by about 2.02x.
